text:
elaine: Quick sync — launch microlanding redirect naming convention before next Friday :rocket:

elaine: Need to lock redirects, canonical, schema, and kw mapping for the webinar posts. Minimal changes; keep internal links predictable.

sam: Agreed. What's the canonical pattern? /launch/<slug> or /resources/<slug>?

elaine: Prefer /launch/<yyyy-mm>-<slug> for campaign tracking and to avoid archive bounces.

noah: Can we standardize UTM appending in redirects (so inbound lead routing picks it up)? e.g., add ?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=microlanding

ravi: Also need messaging variants — short headline + long post. I'll push a microcopy pass once redirects are final.

sam: Quick SEO checks: keyword mapping sheet -> make primary keyword in H1, schema JSON-LD on page, internal link from /resources hub.

sam: Also watch for orphaned pages; add at least 2 internal links from top-level docs.

seo-bot: crawl-report: 1 warning: duplicate meta description on /launch/2024-q2-microlanding

elaine: Thanks @sam, @ravi, @noah. I'll update the redirects doc and drop mapping in #marketing-assets.

elaine: Redirect examples:

```bash
# 1: preserve utms
/source/webinar-2024 -> /launch/2024-05-microlanding?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=2024_microlanding
# 2: force-canonical
/old-path -> /launch/2024-05-microlanding 301
```

sam: Schema snippet to include (JSON-LD):

```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"Microlanding Webinar","author":"Redwood Marketing"}
```

noah: For inbound lead routing, we'll parse utm_campaign and route leads to webinar nurture playbook. I'll add routing rules to the docs.

ravi: I'll prepare two messaging variants and sample CTAs by EOD tomorrow.

elaine: Action items: 
- elaine: update redirects doc + add canonical rules
- sam: validate schema + internal link plan
- noah: add routing rules for utm_campaign
- ravi: messaging variants

elaine: Ping me if you need the keyword sheet link, will post in thread. :eyeglasses:

noah: Thx — putting it on my calendar to review routing after ravi's copy.

sam: will run a quick QA after everything's merged.

elaine: Great, close loop on Friday. :white_check_mark:
